scope: Released material-builder inputs and registered armor constructors; defense/toughness inputs are not final damage reduction, and set effects require separate method review.

vanilla_formula.scope: Official vanilla 1.21.1 reference formula. Loader patches, item overrides and live components are not certified by this calculation.

limits: Full-set and per-piece special effects are not summarized by these base material values
Durability multiplier is passed to ArmorItem.Type.getDurability; it is not the final item durability
Empty normal repair ingredient does not rule out every other repair system
Skill helmets carry an unbreakable component; do not present ordinary wear as their expected behavior
